evidence.title: Wyoming governor says DOJ poll monitors were 'a bit aggressive'

occurrences.checkable_against: Transcript or recording of Gov. Mark Gordon's Wednesday meeting remarks
occurrences.quote_span: I feel very strongly about the federal government coming in and taking our guns. I don’t like that. I don’t like the federal government coming in and taking our votes, either,” Gordon said at the meeting Wednesday.
occurrences.speaker: Mark Gordon
occurrences.subject: U.S. Department of Justice election monitors in Laramie County

occurrences.checkable_against: Wyoming election law
occurrences.quote_span: Wyoming law allows only election observation by certified poll watchers who monitor registration and turnout, Lee said.
occurrences.speaker: Debra Lee
occurrences.subject: U.S. Department of Justice election monitors in Laramie County

occurrences.checkable_against: Debra Lee's statement and Wyoming election administration records
occurrences.quote_span: “This was a poorly managed exercise and one that showed complete disregard for our state laws and administration of our elections,” Lee said in the statement.
occurrences.speaker: Debra Lee
occurrences.subject: U.S. Department of Justice election monitors in Laramie County

occurrences.checkable_against: Laramie County Clerk statement and election-day access logs
occurrences.quote_span: The monitors arrived soon after polls opened at 7 a.m. on primary day and said they intended to interview voters while assessing compliance with federal civil rights and voting rights laws, Laramie County Clerk Debra Lee said in a statement.
occurrences.speaker: Debra Lee
occurrences.subject: U.S. Department of Justice election monitors in Laramie County

occurrences.checkable_against: Darin Smith's primary-day statement
occurrences.quote_span: He said monitors would be in the state “to ensure transparency, ballot security, and strict compliance with federal voting rights statutes.”
occurrences.speaker: Darin Smith
occurrences.subject: U.S. Department of Justice election monitors in Laramie County

occurrences.checkable_against: Laramie County election office policies and records
occurrences.quote_span: Lee said her office didn’t allow interviews to be conducted in polling places and denied the monitors permission to do so.
occurrences.speaker: Debra Lee
occurrences.subject: U.S. Department of Justice election monitors in Laramie County

occurrences.checkable_against: Justice Department deployment decision records and email records
occurrences.quote_span: A Justice Department official in Washington told her the decision to send them was made on short notice and an email was sent to her but “may have gone to the wrong address,” Lee said.
occurrences.speaker: Justice Department official in Washington
occurrences.subject: U.S. Department of Justice election monitors in Laramie County

occurrences.checkable_against: Laramie County Clerk statement and interview records
occurrences.quote_span: The monitors questioned local officials about “the nature, length and timing of poll worker training,” Lee said.
occurrences.speaker: Debra Lee
occurrences.subject: U.S. Department of Justice election monitors in Laramie County

occurrences.checkable_against: DOJ press-office correspondence and Darin Smith's primary-day statement
occurrences.quote_span: The DOJ did not answer questions about the monitors Friday but referred to a primary day statement by Darin Smith, the U.S. attorney for Wyoming.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: U.S. Department of Justice election monitors in Laramie County

occurrences.checkable_against: Laramie County Clerk statement and election equipment access records
occurrences.quote_span: “Monitors requested training guides, asked how our new election equipment was acquired and wanted to examine our tabulators,” Lee said.
occurrences.speaker: Debra Lee
occurrences.subject: U.S. Department of Justice election monitors in Laramie County

occurrences.checkable_against: Wyoming secretary of state's office communications records
occurrences.quote_span: Gray told Gordon at the elections meeting that his office “got an email,” but that was all the communication it had with the Justice Department about the federal officials.
occurrences.speaker: Chuck Gray
occurrences.subject: U.S. Department of Justice election monitors in Laramie County

occurrences.checkable_against: Darin Smith's primary-day statement
occurrences.quote_span: “We are working alongside local officials to ensure every lawful vote is protected.”
occurrences.speaker: Darin Smith
occurrences.subject: U.S. Department of Justice election monitors in Laramie County

occurrences.checkable_against: Chuck Gray's 2022 campaign records and rally materials
occurrences.quote_span: Trump’s fraud claims about the 2020 election have been amplified by Wyoming’s Republican secretary of state, Chuck Gray, who successfully ran in 2022 in part by showing a discredited documentary about those claims at campaign rallies across the state.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: U.S. Department of Justice election monitors in Laramie County

occurrences.checkable_against: Wyoming statutes governing the attorney general and executive-branch organization
occurrences.quote_span: Appointed by the governor, Wyoming’s attorney general works mainly in the service of the executive branch and is not politically independent as in other states.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: U.S. Department of Justice election monitors in Laramie County

occurrences.checkable_against: Transcript or recording of the elections meeting
occurrences.quote_span: “Certainly happy to visit with the attorney general,” Gray told the governor during the meeting. “Transparency is so important, and accountability.”
occurrences.speaker: Chuck Gray
occurrences.subject: U.S. Department of Justice election monitors in Laramie County

occurrences.checkable_against: Public statements by voting rights groups and Justice Department voting-enforcement policy records
occurrences.quote_span: Voting rights groups have raised concern about President Donald Trump’s Justice Department shifting priorities away from enforcing civil rights laws with respect to voting.
occurrences.speaker: Voting rights groups
occurrences.subject: U.S. Department of Justice election monitors in Laramie County

occurrences.checkable_against: Mark Gordon's public statements and official term records
occurrences.quote_span: Approaching the end of his second and final term in office, Gordon has publicly expressed little if any previous criticism of federal polices under Trump.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: U.S. Department of Justice election monitors in Laramie County

occurrences.checkable_against: Laramie County election office records and DOJ monitor deployment records
occurrences.quote_span: The monitoring happened in southeastern Wyoming’s Laramie County, home to the state capital, Cheyenne.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: U.S. Department of Justice election monitors in Laramie County

occurrences.checkable_against: Darin Smith's primary-day statement
occurrences.quote_span: “Voters deserve absolute confidence that their ballots are secure and their voices are heard without interference,” Smith said in the statement.
occurrences.speaker: Darin Smith
occurrences.subject: U.S. Department of Justice election monitors in Laramie County

occurrences.checkable_against: Laramie County Clerk communications records
occurrences.quote_span: She said she hadn’t been notified the monitors would be in Laramie County.
occurrences.speaker: Debra Lee
occurrences.subject: U.S. Department of Justice election monitors in Laramie County

occurrences.checkable_against: Justice Department election-monitoring policies and deployment records
occurrences.quote_span: The Justice Department routinely sends monitors to observe polling places or election offices, but they are not supposed to interfere with voting or election administration.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: U.S. Department of Justice election monitors in Laramie County

occurrences.checkable_against: Wyoming election law
occurrences.quote_span: Wyoming law allows election observers, Gray said.
occurrences.speaker: Chuck Gray
occurrences.subject: U.S. Department of Justice election monitors in Laramie County

occurrences.checkable_against: Trump directives to federal prosecutors and certified 2020 election results
occurrences.quote_span: Trump instead has directed federal prosecutors to search for fraud in the 2020 election, which he lost to Democrat Joe Biden .
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: U.S. Department of Justice election monitors in Laramie County

occurrences.checkable_against: Wyoming primary election results and Chuck Gray's candidacy filings
occurrences.quote_span: Gray is not seeking reelection as secretary of state and won the Republican nomination for Wyoming’s seat in the U.S. House during the primary.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: U.S. Department of Justice election monitors in Laramie County
